args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 shipped to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the v2.3.1 regression that left checkout-api unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment required and received change-manager approval since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production. Post-deploy verification: service healthy across all regions, error rate reduced to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Deployed checkout-api v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, the deploy required change-manager approval, which was granted.
2. **Verified the fix**: the service is now healthy across all regions, with the error rate dropping from 18% (on the unhealthy v2.3.1) to 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV3 incident (INC-0001)** for checkout-api documenting the hotfix change, the approval, and the post-deploy verification results; on-call has been paged.
